d: Namaste, Triumph India responded quickly to GST changes and reduced its 398cc engines to 349cc to keep prices low for customers. They started with Speed, Scrambler, and Thruxton, but also added a brand-new bike, the Tracker, to the lineup. Here is a video on what has changed and what the Tracker is all about. I also rode the Speed and Tracker to share my thoughts on their ride.
